Corviknight (109/205, Shell Bell, Mirror Armor) is my only active attacker. decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Checking matchups: Corviknight at 109/205 HP, mega Scizor at 71%. Body Press is Fighting-type, which hits Scizor's Steel typing for double damage but gets resisted by its Bug typing, so the net effect against Bug/Steel ends up roughly neutral.

Brave Bird, though, is 2x effective since Flying beats Bug outright and only gets resisted neutrally by Steel, so it's actually the stronger STAB option despite the 33% recoil — risky at Corviknight's current HP but could be a big hit. Meanwhile, Scizor's priority Bullet Punch with Technician boost is still weakened since Steel doesn't hit Corviknight's Steel/Flying typing hard, so Corviknight should be fairly safe from that particular threat.

Crunching numbers roughly, Brave Bird could land around 90-100+ damage on mega Scizor, potentially threatening a KO given its ~113 remaining HP, while Body Press using Corviknight's high Defense stat as attack would deal solid neutral damage too, though less than the super-effective Brave Bird. The bigger worry is Rotom's Electric attacks, which hit Corviknight for double damage through its Flying typing.

Hydro Pump would surely finish off a 38 HP Incineroar, so Protect is the safer play—it forces Rotom to waste the turn and lets Leftovers chip in some recovery. I'll go with Protect.
